paper.title_en: Supermassive black hole binaries in the multi-messenger context of ground and spaceborne VLBI
paper.abstract_en: Evidence of a gravitational wave background suggests the existence of a population of sub-parsec supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs), with characteristic angular separations on the order of 1-10 $μ$as. Spaceborne extensions of Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) and the next generation ground arrays introduce the possibility of directly imaging these SMBHBs. In this work, a binary spectral energy distribution model is used to predict the detectability of SMBHBs with ground and spaceborne VLBI. We consider the Black Hole Explorer (BHEX), a proposed spaceborne VLBI mission, as our primary case study. We explore the detectable SMBHB parameter space and identify distinguishable binary signatures in the visibility domain. We find that for a flux-density-limited sample, ground array observations are more effective at detecting a wider region of the binary parameter space, with $M_\mathrm{tot} \gtrsim 10^9$ solar mass systems detectable out to redshift $z=0.075$ and beyond, depending on mass ratio. Conversely, inclusion of a spaceborne element such as BHEX, offering finer angular resolution ($\sim6\,μ$as) and sampling of the (u,v) plane not limited by Earth rotation synthesis, will provide significant benefits in constraining binary properties. An illustrative Fisher analysis shows improvements in characterisation of the separation and position angle of SMBHBs by a factor of $\sim4$. Near-future ground and/or spaceborne VLBI may achieve the first direct observation of a SMBHB, contributing significantly to multi-messenger studies of such systems with pulsar timing arrays and observations across the electromagnetic spectrum.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）的VLBI直接成像预测与脉冲星计时阵列所探测的纳赫兹引力波背景这一多信使语境相联系，与pta主题相关。摘要清晰描述了模型方法与可探测参数空间的定量结论，理论深度与方法学信号较强，具有较好的前沿价值。
decision.title_zh: 地基与天基VLBI多信使语境下的超大质量黑洞双星
decision.abstract_zh: 引力波背景的证据表明存在一个亚秒差距超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）族群，其特征角间距约为1-10 $\mu$as。甚长基线干涉测量（VLBI）的天基扩展以及下一代地基阵列带来了直接对这些SMBHB成像的可能性。在本工作中，我们使用双星谱能量分布模型来预测地基与天基VLBI对SMBHB的可探测性。我们考虑黑洞探测者（BHEX）——一个拟议的天基VLBI任务——作为我们的主要案例研究。我们探索了可探测的SMBHB参数空间，并识别出可见度域中可区分的双星特征。我们发现，对于流量密度受限的样本，地基阵列观测在探测更广泛的双星参数空间区域方面更为有效，根据质量比不同，总质量$M_\mathrm{tot} \gtrsim 10^9$太阳质量的系统可被探测至红移$z=0.075$及更远。相反，加入诸如BHEX这样的天基要素——提供更精细的角分辨率（$\sim6\,\mu$as）以及不受地球自转综合限制的(u,v)平面采样——将显著有助于约束双星性质。一个示例性的Fisher分析显示，对SMBHB间距和位置角的表征改善了约4倍。近期地基和/或天基VLBI可能实现对SMBHB的首次直接观测，从而借助脉冲星计时阵列以及跨越电磁波谱的观测，显著促进对此类系统的多信使研究。
